choice: Accept the absence of full three-dimensional finite-contact atomistic validation as an explicit scope boundary for the present paper, provided all headline wording remains restricted to the published-GSFE-anchored finite-contact model hierarchy.
rationale: The retained scientific claims are computational claims about a DFT/GSFE-anchored reduced finite-contact model, supported by symmetry controls, dense continuation, compact-contact scaling, two independent in-plane relaxation representations, deterministic numerical audits, and stationary trajectory-level statistics. Full 3D atomistics would constitute a higher model layer and a separate research branch rather than evidence required by the narrowed headline claim.
boundary: No claim may state or imply validation for arbitrary fully three-dimensional Janus MoSSe contacts, collective out-of-plane reconstruction, atomistically reconstructed edges, device-scale calibration, or a physical polarity-reversal law. Any future addition of such material-level claims reopens N27-R01.
